newsitem.title: USA: Enova refund to natgas customers approved.
newsitem.headline: Enova refund to natgas customers approved.

text.p: Enova Corp's plan for a one-time refund of $12 million to natural gas customers of its San Diego Gas & Electric Co subsidiary was approved Monday by California Public Utilities Commission.
The refund represents about 15 percent off the average customer bill, the utility said.

Donald Felsinger, chief executive officer of SDG&E, said, "The bill credit our customers will see this month reflects how successful we have been at buying natural gas at more competitive prices than forecast."

Historically, natgas prices were forecast at the beginning of the year and then averaged over a 12-month period. When SDG&E buys natgas at prices less than those forecasts, the savings are passed on to customers in the form of bill refunds.
SDG&E has adopted a new billing system that now adjusts customer natural gas rates on a monthly basis to reflect the actual prices of natural gas on the open market.
